abstract: Teratoid tumours of the oropharynx are notorious for obstructing the airways and interfering with alimentation. We report here a healthy 20-day old neonate who presented with a painless growth in the floor of the mouth from birth. In this neonate, the tumour interfered with breast-feeding but not with bottle-feeding which the child tolerated very well. At operation, the tumour was easily enucleated, weighed 6G and was histologically consistent with a teratoma. The commonest site for this tumour is the nasopharynx and only 26 oropharyngeal teratomas have been reported in the English literature. The differential diagnosis of congenital oral growths should include a teratoma.
abstract_ja: 生後20日の健康な新生児が、口腔底に出生時から存在する無痛性の腫瘤を呈した。腫瘍は母乳哺育を妨げたが、哺乳瓶による授乳は良好に行われた。手術時、腫瘍は容易に摘出され、重量は6グラムで、組織学的に奇形腫と一致した。この腫瘍の好発部位は上咽頭であり、英文文献で報告された口腔咽頭奇形腫は26例のみである。先天性口腔腫瘤の鑑別診断には奇形腫を含めるべきである。
